cmd:
set -eo pipefail; DRIVE_OUT=/content/drive/MyDrive/koi_waymo2pano_colab/outputs/phase3/t11_gen3c; T9B=/content/drive/MyDrive/koi_waymo2pano_colab/outputs/phase3/t9b_vipe_depth; LOG="$DRIVE_OUT/infer_log_v1.txt"; mkdir -p "$DRIVE_OUT"; exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1; echo "[t11-infer-v1] start $(date -u)"; nvidia-smi 2>&1 | head -6; df -h /content /content/drive 2>&1 | head -6; INSTALL_DONE="$DRIVE_OUT/install_done_v2.json"; if [ ! -f "$INSTALL_DONE" ]; then echo '[t11-infer-v1] ERROR: install_done_v2.json not found; install likely failed or not yet run. Aborting.'; echo '{"status":"aborted_install_not_done"}' > "$DRIVE_OUT/infer_done_v1.json"; exit 0; fi; cat "$INSTALL_DONE"; SMOKE_OK=$(python -c "import json; v=json.load(open('$INSTALL_DONE')); print(v.get('smoke_text_contains_success', False) or v.get('smoke_rc', -1) == 0)"); APEX_OK=$(python -c "import json; v=json.load(open('$INSTALL_DONE')); print(v.get('apex_ok', 0))"); CKPT_GB=$(python -c "import json; v=json.load(open('$INSTALL_DONE')); print(v.get('checkpoints_size_gb', 0))"); echo "install verdict: smoke_ok=$SMOKE_OK apex_ok=$APEX_OK ckpt_gb=$CKPT_GB"; if [ "$CKPT_GB" = "0" ] || [ "$CKPT_GB" = "0.0" ]; then echo '[t11-infer-v1] ERROR: checkpoints_size_gb=0, install seems incomplete. Aborting.'; echo '{"status":"aborted_no_ckpts"}' > "$DRIVE_OUT/infer_done_v1.json"; exit 0; fi; source $HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh; set +u; conda activate cosmos-predict1; set -u; GEN3C_DIR=/content/GEN3C; if [ ! -d $GEN3C_DIR ]; then echo '[t11-infer-v1] ERROR: /content/GEN3C missing, install lost across restart? Aborting.'; echo '{"status":"aborted_gen3c_missing"}' > "$DRIVE_OUT/infer_done_v1.json"; exit 0; fi; echo '---stage ViPE inputs to /content---'; LOCAL_VIPE=/content/vipe_in; rm -rf $LOCAL_VIPE; mkdir -p $LOCAL_VIPE/{rgb,depth,pose,intrinsics,mask}; cp $T9B/rgb/l1_erp.mp4 $LOCAL_VIPE/rgb/; cp $T9B/depth/l1_erp.zip $LOCAL_VIPE/depth/; cp $T9B/pose/l1_erp.npz $LOCAL_VIPE/pose/; cp $T9B/intrinsics/l1_erp.npz $LOCAL_VIPE/intrinsics/; cp $T9B/intrinsics/l1_erp_camera.txt $LOCAL_VIPE/intrinsics/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp $T9B/mask/l1_erp.zip $LOCAL_VIPE/mask/ 2>/dev/null || true; ls -la $LOCAL_VIPE/*/; echo '---fire GEN3C dynamic inference---'; mkdir -p /content/gen3c_out; t0=$(date +%s); CUDA_HOME=$CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONPATH=$GEN3C_DIR python $GEN3C_DIR/cosmos_predict1/diffusion/inference/gen3c_dynamic.py --checkpoint_dir $DRIVE_OUT/checkpoints --vipe_path $LOCAL_VIPE --vipe_starting_frame_idx 0 --video_save_name gen3c_t11_l1_erp_left --video_save_folder /content/gen3c_out/ --num_video_frames 121 --height 704 --width 1280 --trajectory left --camera_rotation center_facing --movement_distance 0.3 --guidance 1 --num_steps 35 --fps 24 --seed 1 --num_gpus 1 --offload_diffusion_transformer --offload_tokenizer --offload_text_encoder_model --offload_prompt_upsampler --offload_guardrail_models --disable_guardrail --disable_prompt_encoder --foreground_masking --filter_points_threshold 0.05 2>&1 | tail -100 || echo '[t11-infer-v1] INFERENCE FAILED'; t1=$(date +%s); echo "inference wall: $((t1-t0))s"; echo '---persist outputs to Drive---'; cp -r /content/gen3c_out/* "$DRIVE_OUT/" 2>&1 | tail -5 || true; nvidia-smi > "$DRIVE_OUT/nvidia_smi_post.txt"; ls -la "$DRIVE_OUT/"; echo '---summary---'; python -c "
import json, os, subprocess
mp4 = '$DRIVE_OUT/gen3c_t11_l1_erp_left.mp4'
size = os.path.getsize(mp4) if os.path.exists(mp4) else 0
frames = 0
if size:
    try:
        out = subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-select_streams','v:0','-count_frames','-show_entries','stream=nb_read_frames','-of','csv=p=0',mp4]).decode().strip()
        frames = int(out) if out.isdigit() else 0
    except Exception as e:
        pass
s = {
    'mp4_exists': bool(size),
    'mp4_size_mb': round(size/1e6, 2),
    'frame_count': frames,
    'inference_wall_s': $((t1-t0)),
    'input_vipe_path': '$T9B',
    'trajectory': 'left',
    'verdict': 'ok' if frames >= 121 else ('partial' if size > 0 else 'failed'),
}
print(json.dumps(s, indent=2))
open('$DRIVE_OUT/infer_done_v1.json','w').write(json.dumps(s, indent=2))
" 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "[t11-infer-v1] done $(date -u)"
